command_edges.transaction_boundary: one UnitOfWork validates bounded name, inserts one receipt, allocates immutable Product Line id, inserts active row and audit atomically
command_edges.revision_effects: new Customer-neutral Product Line revision 1 only; no Contract/CPL/SLA policy is created implicitly
command_edges.idempotency: COMMAND_ENVELOPE_V1; replay returns original Product Line identity and result refs

command_edges.transaction_boundary: one UnitOfWork revalidates Product Line/base revision then receipt/update/audit commit; equal semantic name is NO_CHANGE
command_edges.revision_effects: Product Line descriptive revision advances only; Contract/CPL policy and completed report labels remain unchanged
command_edges.idempotency: COMMAND_ENVELOPE_V1 + base revision; equal semantic value is NO_CHANGE

command_edges.transaction_boundary: one UnitOfWork proves referenced Customer active then inserts receipt, immutable Customer-owned Contract identity and audit
command_edges.revision_effects: new Contract revision 1; Customer ownership is immutable and no Product Line is attached implicitly
command_edges.idempotency: COMMAND_ENVELOPE_V1; replay returns original Customer-owned Contract identity

command_edges.transaction_boundary: policy/template validation occurs outside lock; one UnitOfWork revalidates active Contract/Product Line then receipt/CPL and optional immutable initial policy tiers/current pointer/audit commit atomically
command_edges.revision_effects: new CPL revision 1; optional initial policy becomes revision 1 only for this CPL/Customer Contract; Product Line remains reusable Customer-neutral identity
command_edges.idempotency: COMMAND_ENVELOPE_V1; replay cannot create a second CPL or policy revision

command_edges.transaction_boundary: exact percentage/rational-duration/template validation outside lock; one UnitOfWork revalidates active CPL/Contract/current-policy pointer then receipt, immutable policy revision+tiers, current pointer advance and audit atomically
command_edges.revision_effects: CPL revision/current-policy pointer advances; prior policy revisions immutable; current applicable SR SLA/cohort reads use new policy without per-SR rewrites
command_edges.idempotency: COMMAND_ENVELOPE_V1 + CPL/current-policy base state; replay cannot allocate duplicate revision ordinal

command_edges.transaction_boundary: one UnitOfWork revalidates exact target/base revision and bounded dependency guards before receipt/lifecycle revision/audit commit
command_edges.revision_effects: target lifecycle/revision advances only; archived history/classifications/reports remain readable and no dependent authority is deleted
command_edges.idempotency: COMMAND_ENVELOPE_V1 + exact target/base state; already desired eligible state is NO_CHANGE

command_edges.transaction_boundary: account code normalization outside lock; one UnitOfWork revalidates Customer and active CPL/Contract exact Customer compatibility then receipt/mapping/audit
command_edges.revision_effects: new mapping revision 1; no uniqueness is asserted and no SR classification is changed automatically by mapping creation
command_edges.idempotency: COMMAND_ENVELOPE_V1; replay cannot duplicate mapping identity

command_edges.transaction_boundary: one UnitOfWork revalidates active mapping/base revision then receipt, closes mapping, advances revision and audits
command_edges.revision_effects: mapping becomes inactive with history retained; prior automatic classification events are not rewritten
command_edges.idempotency: COMMAND_ENVELOPE_V1 + mapping revision; already superseded state replays/NO_CHANGE

command_edges.transaction_boundary: one UnitOfWork rereads SR resolved Customer/source input token, target CPL/Contract lifecycle/current policy, unique mapping when automatic and current classification before receipt and append-only assign/reclassify event/current projection/audit
command_edges.revision_effects: classification history appends and current projection changes; SR Customer/lifecycle/source remain owner-controlled; live SLA recalculates by derivation only
command_edges.idempotency: COMMAND_ENVELOPE_V1 + exact preview/base token; same current target is semantic NO_CHANGE

command_edges.transaction_boundary: one UnitOfWork revalidates exact current classification revision then receipt, append-only clear event, current projection removal and audit
command_edges.revision_effects: current SR classification becomes unclassified while all classification history/completed reports remain
command_edges.idempotency: COMMAND_ENVELOPE_V1 + current classification revision; replay cannot duplicate clear evidence

command_edges.transaction_boundary: batch preview is read-only; each selected eligible target invokes ClassifyServiceRequest as its own short idempotent UnitOfWork and records independent disposition, never one giant writer transaction
command_edges.revision_effects: only successfully applied per-SR classification projections/events advance; stale/incompatible targets remain unchanged; aggregate batch audit is bounded metadata
command_edges.idempotency: COMMAND_ENVELOPE_V1 at batch boundary plus per-target COMMAND_ENVELOPE_V1 derived identities/base tokens; retries preserve already committed target results

command_edges.transaction_boundary: uses already-open caller UnitOfWork/receipt; if current CPL Contract Customer is incompatible, append invalidate_customer event/remove current classification/add owner audit result; never commit or create nested receipt
command_edges.revision_effects: incompatible current classification is invalidated only; no replacement CPL is selected and SR Customer mutation remains LLD-03 authority
command_edges.idempotency: shared outer COMMAND_ENVELOPE_V1; repeated same-UoW compatible/absent classification is NO_CHANGE and cannot duplicate invalidation event
